description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small ancient ruin and rock props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell, in this exact order left to right, top to bottom: wide crumbling section of old gray stone brick wall spanning the whole cell width; small stone gargoyle statue crouching on a square stone pedestal; large round gray boulder; short flight of worn gray stone stairs; fallen broken gray stone column lying on its side; iron brazier bowl on three legs with burning orange fire; jagged gray rock outcrop; tall thin pointed gray rock spire; upright gray stone tablet carved with glowing blue runes, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, weathered gray stone colors, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no numbers, no characters
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one small object centered in each cell of the 3 by 3 grid. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
